title: 03 · ganesha_head · Why Ganesha Has an Elephant's Head
lines: A small boy once stood in a doorway and told Shiva, You cannot enter.
A small boy once stood in a doorway and told Shiva, "You cannot enter."
Parvati had made the boy that morning,
from the sandal paste on her own skin.
Guard my door, she said. Let no one in.
"Guard my door," she said. "Let no one in."
He did not know who Shiva was.
Shiva did not know who he was.
The Ganas tried to move him. All of them.
When Parvati saw what had been done,
Bring the head of the first creature you find, said Shiva, sleeping with its head to the north.
"Bring the head of the first creature you find," said Shiva, "sleeping with its head to the north."
leader of all his people, first to be worshipped, before every god.
He never moved from his mother's door.
So now he stands at every door.
Loyalty before understanding. That is sadhana.
